notes.title: Shibui Coliseum v 1.1 (February 2024)
notes.notes:
It's been a while, but this update is well worth your wait.

- Adjusted overall difficulty level to much less overbearing, especially for the Beehive Challenge
- Arena 3, Ghost Storage, can now be accessed without completing the previous arenas
- The game is now 64-bit making those loading times a breeze
- The Shibui Intruder now has more firepower
- The amount of levels has been cut down to 50 from 100, making it easier to access the later arenas
- You have two new bonuses to help you in eradicating your foes
